'''s()l(), Han deal with it!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[s()l(), Han]]
* '''Published:''' 16 November 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif|label=This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Deal Han DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a fun deck that I play in some fun classics. The players I play with use classic rules but with one exception NO (V) cards I know I know I said the same thing when I heard it, but it is really fun and is a challenge!

The published list has 58 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 58 as published: the Effects header says 11 but lists 10, and the Interrupts header says 10 but lists 9.
* Classic format with no (V) cards (stated in the post). The author's edit (one Cloud City Occupation, Jodo Kast and one other card out; two Sense and an Alter in) is not applied.
* Posted Iggy with gun dested IG-88 With Riot Gun; Vader with stick dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; Bossk in bus dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Zukkus in milf hunter' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; Fett in ship dested Boba Fett In Slave I. No Escape (Effects section) is the Effect.

== Strategy ==

part of the rules that the group i play with is that it is classic format and no (V) cards!

edit: i took out one CC occupation and jodo cast and something else and put in two senses and an alter!

Strategy:

Well these guys are old school players, and i believe they got out right as episode 1 cards came out. so when we showed up to their first tournament we surprised them with (V) cards. That pissed them off something bad and even pushed some of them to say we couldn’t win without them… well I had to prove them wrong so I built this deal and a TRM just so I could prove them wrong. I got 2nd behind a guy who was playing some decks that were just prehistoric beasts and the guy was at one time a world caliber player.

-Crush is a beast here it limits their destiny and all non-scrub players should use this card regardless. Plus it pulls my destiny adders for my Dark jedi and it also pulls that tech card I like to call evader and monnok! Other than that everything is pretty straight forward and if you have any questions please d-mail me prior to your rating so I can give you the info to make a proper rating.

Ok first turn pull with mob points, activate, look with crush (while in there look for stuff to pull with im sorry, IAO, and the objective), then depending on what you saw pull your stuff. If you are missing something try to do anything you can to get your stuff . once you get occupation and deal out you should be set for the rest of the game, but if you want to add insult to injury put down search and destroy too. Use reactor terminal to put your hand back in to bolster your win and just don’t make any scrub mistakes.
